name: Holon-Energie PE
effect: Holon Energy GL provides  Energy. If the Pokémon that Holon Energy GL is attached to also has a basic  Energy card attached to it, that Pokémon can't be affected by any Special Conditions. If the Pokémon that Holon Energy GL is attached to also has a basic  Energy card attached to it, damage done by your opponent's Pokémon-ex is reduced by 10. Ignore these effects if Holon Energy GL is attached to Pokémon-ex.
author: Takumi Akabane
